_about: Stage 1 of the expiry_condition work order (2026-11-10). One row per PENDING / UNKNOWN slot. expiry_condition is filled only where the slot's own text, docstring or cited source states an instrument class, sensitivity or protocol AND what its null result does to the entry; otherwise VOID. Nothing here was inferred. stated_partial records text that names a protocol or a resolution condition without a null-result rule; it is not an exit.

status_vocabulary_addition.ABSENT_AT_SENSITIVITY(<value>): scoped absence: looked for with a stated instrument class / sensitivity / protocol and not found at that sensitivity. Never written as bare 'absent'. No slot holds this status yet.

slot_rule: A slot is one place where the tree HOLDS a value in the state PENDING or UNKNOWN: a recorded data value, or a code site that assigns or returns that state. Not slots: vocabulary declarations and legends, prose stating a rule, comparisons and handlers, tests and selftest fixtures, docs/readme_archive/, CLAUDE.md, CONFLICTS.md.

silent_fills.about: SILENT_FILL = C7 without the label: a default fills a missing input and the output reads as if the input had been supplied. The PENDING/UNKNOWN slot rule cannot see it, because no PENDING or UNKNOWN value is ever held. Rows here cover sweep ranks 1, 2, 3, 6. Rank 7 (UNKNOWN severity 1 -> YELLOW) is out of scope, awaiting review. expiry_condition uses the slot guard: own stated exit, else VOID. None of these sites states an exit. Rows added 2026-11-11 (SF-R1b..d, SF-AD1..3) have no switch yet; the three-way switch for them is deferred.

fail_direction_vocabulary.OPEN: the fill reads the missing input in the direction that relaxes the verdict
fail_direction_vocabulary.SAFE: the fill reads the missing input in the direction that tightens the verdict
fail_direction_vocabulary.UNSIGNED: the fill is a midpoint or table value; whether it relaxes or tightens the verdict depends on the true value it replaces (added 2026-11-11)
